definitions.explanation: A difficult or troublesome situation; an obstacle or challenge.
A fault or weakness in something.

examples.japanese: {難|なん}を{逃|のが}れることができた。
examples.english: I was able to escape the danger.

examples.japanese: この{計画|けいかく}には{一|ひと}つ{難|なん}がある。
examples.english: There is one flaw in this plan.

examples.japanese: {難|なん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えて{成功|せいこう}した。

notes:
{難|なん} can mean both 'difficulty/danger' and 'defect/flaw' depending on context.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {難|なん}を{逃|のが}れる: to escape danger/difficulty
- {難|なん}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}える: to overcome difficulties
- {難|なん}がある: to have a flaw/problem
- {難|なん}のない: flawless, without problems

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {困難|こんなん}: difficulty, hardship
- {災難|さいなん}: disaster, misfortune
- {避難|ひなん}: evacuation, refuge
- {難民|なんみん}: refugee
